title: `transferFee()` uses an incorrect transfer method
summary: _Resolved_   ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `transferFee` function in the `TheCounter` contract incorrectly uses `safeTransferFrom` instead of `safeTransfer` when transferring collected fees from the contract to the admin. This implementation error will cause the function to revert due to missing allowances.
